services.name: Sunset Cruise Tour
services.desc: Find a Sunset state of mind Cruising in comfort on our Paradise Sunset tour on Beautiful lake Havasu. Spend the Golden Hour out on the water Soaking in the Gorgeous landscape watching as the sun dips below the horizon creating one of the most serene sunsets you will ever see. Bring a picnic and drinks to toast as the last bit of daylight fades away. Paradise Boat Tours of Lake Havasu Sunset Tour will first start about 2.hours before sunset. Start times will vary. We then run down to Copper canyon and then down to Point rock lighthouse. On the way you will learn about the history of the area and the Bridge.
